reply:
**Claim RBv1-CLM-06_r1: Thomas Petit, policy VER-1004**

**1. Status:** Settlement prepared for human approval. The claims system returned `pending_approval` for the settlement (payout €1,200). A human claims handler must approve it before any payment is made.

**2. Facts recorded**
- Policy VER-1004, policyholder Thomas Petit, who was the driver. No other driver is mentioned.
- Coverage C2 (collision damage to the insured car) is in the Policy Schedule. C1 is also listed.
- Vehicle: VW Golf (2020), market value €15,500. Driving licence held since 1 Nov 2008 (17 years at the incident date).
- Incident on 8 Oct 2026, reported on 10 Oct 2026 (2 days after the incident).
- Rear-end collision in a traffic jam. The customer states it was his fault. The other party is named only as "Mr. Blanc", with no first name or policy details.
- Repair quote for the customer's own car: €1,500.
- Attachments recorded as provided: damage_photos.zip, repair_quote.pdf, accident_report_signed.pdf. I could not open these files, so I have not checked their contents.

**3. Reasoning**
- **Coverage:** C2 covers damage to the insured vehicle after a collision, and it is listed in the Policy Schedule. The claim is not referred for coverage reasons (Art. 2).
- **Reporting:** The claim was reported within 5 days of the incident, so it is on time (Art. 4.1). It is not a late claim under Art. 7.1.
- **Documents:** For C2, the required documents are photos of the damage, a repair quote, and an accident report signed by both drivers when a third party is involved (Art. 4.3). All three were received, so no request for documents is needed.
- **Possible exclusions:** Nothing in the email suggests an Art. 3 exclusion (alcohol, drugs, licence, racing, intentional damage, or wear). Being at fault in a collision is not an exclusion under Art. 3, so I have not referred the claim for that reason. The claim is not referred to a handler (Art. 7).
- **Deductible:** The standard C2 deductible is €300 (Art. 2). The not-at-fault waiver (Art. 5.2) does not apply, because the customer admits fault. The young-driver surcharge (Art. 5.3) does not apply, because the licence is more than 3 years old.
- **Payout:** Compensation is the repair cost, capped at market value, minus the deductible (Art. 6.2). Here: €1,500 − €300 = €1,200. This figure comes from the claims system's settlement calculation.
- **Payment timing:** Payment is made within 15 days after a Veridia claims handler approves the compensation (Art. 6.3).

**4. Amounts (from the settlement calculation only)**
- Deductible: €300 (Art. 2)
- Payout: €1,200 (Art. 6.2)
- Independent assessor required: No. Assessor inspection applies only when the repair cost is above €1,500 (Art. 6.1), and the quote is exactly €1,500.

**5. Draft message to the customer**

> Dear Mr. Petit,
>
> Thank you for reporting the accident of 8 October 2026 under policy VER-1004, and for sending the photos, repair quote and signed accident report. Your claim (reference RBv1-CLM-06_r1) has been prepared for review by our claims team. We will write to you again once the review is complete.
>
> Kind regards,
> Veridia Claims
